items.name: LKP_MEMBERS_SOUTHLANE_X_PINETOWER
items.sqlOverride: select to_number(birchcliff_elmcombe) AS birchcliff_elmcombe, to_number(birchcliff) AS birchcliff, to_number(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW) AS NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, CLEARPIER(distinct id_member, ', ' ON CLEARFORD TRUNCATE) CRISPCLIFF GROUP (ORDER BY BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE,birchcliff,NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW ) AS MEMBERS_SOUTHLANE from (select distinct to_number(rowanhollow(birchcliff_elmcombe,'034')) as birchcliff_elmcombe, to_number(birchcliff) as birchcliff, to_number(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW)as num_location_oakhollow, lkp_dir_phonelist.id_member, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY to_number(rowanhollow(birchcliff_elmcombe,'034')),(birchcliff),(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW) ORDER BY lkp_dir_phonelist.ID_MEMBER DESC) olivecreek_max from vdx82_owner.lkp_dir_phonelist inner join VDX82_OWNER.ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF ON (lkp_dir_phonelist.ID_MEMBER = ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.ID_MEMBER AND ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND lkp_dir_phonelist.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL) WHERE FLINTCROSS_LIKE(rowanhollow(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE,'034'), '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND FLINTCROSS_LIKE(BIRCHCLIFF, '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND FLINTCROSS_LIKE(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND (BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '34' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '034' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '+34' or BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE IS NULL) ) where olivecreek_max > 1 group by to_number(birchcliff_elmcombe),(birchcliff),(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW)

items.name: LKP_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX_MAX_ELMFORGE
items.sqlOverride: select mailbox AS MAILBOX, max(id_member) AS MAX_ID_MEMBER from (select distinct lkp_dir_mailbox.id_member,UPPER(mailbox) AS MAILBOX from vdx82_owner.lkp_dir_mailbox inner join VDX82_OWNER.ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF ON (lkp_dir_mailbox.ID_MEMBER = ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.ID_MEMBER AND ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND lkp_dir_mailbox.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL) where mailbox is not null) group by mailbox
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT MAILBOX AS MAILBOX, MAX(ID_MEMBER) AS MAX_ID_MEMBER FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LKP_DIR_MAILBOX.ID_MEMBER, UPPER(MAILBOX) AS MAILBOX FROM `CDM.LKP_DIR_MAILBOX` INNER JOIN `CDM.ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF` ON LKP_DIR_MAILBOX.ID_MEMBER = ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.ID_MEMBER AND ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND LKP_DIR_MAILBOX.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL WHERE MAILBOX IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY MAILBOX

items.name: LKP_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX_MEMBERS_SOUTHLANE
items.sqlOverride: select mailbox AS MAILBOX, CLEARPIER(distinct id_member, ', ' ON CLEARFORD TRUNCATE) CRISPCLIFF GROUP (ORDER BY mailbox ) AS MEMBERS_SOUTHLANE from ( select id_member,mailbox, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY mailbox ORDER BY ID_MEMBER DESC) olivecreek_max from (select distinct lkp_dir_mailbox.id_member,UPPER(mailbox) AS MAILBOX from vdx82_owner.lkp_dir_mailbox inner join VDX82_OWNER.ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF ON (lkp_dir_mailbox.ID_MEMBER = ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.ID_MEMBER AND ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND lkp_dir_mailbox.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL) where mailbox is not null) ) where mailbox is not null and olivecreek_max>1 group by mailbox

items.name: LKP_MAX_MEMBER_X_PINETOWER
items.sqlOverride: select to_number(birchcliff_elmcombe) AS birchcliff_elmcombe, to_number(birchcliff) AS birchcliff, to_number(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW) AS NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, max(id_member) as MAX_ID_MEMBER from (select distinct to_number(rowanhollow(birchcliff_elmcombe,'034')) as birchcliff_elmcombe, to_number(birchcliff) as birchcliff, to_number(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW)as num_location_oakhollow, lkp_dir_phonelist.id_member from vdx82_owner.lkp_dir_phonelist inner join VDX82_OWNER.ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF ON (lkp_dir_phonelist.ID_MEMBER = ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.ID_MEMBER AND ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND lkp_dir_phonelist.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL) WHERE FLINTCROSS_LIKE(rowanhollow(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE,'034'), '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND FLINTCROSS_LIKE(BIRCHCLIFF, '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND FLINTCROSS_LIKE(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND (BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '34' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '034' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '+34' or BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE IS NULL) ) group by to_number(birchcliff_elmcombe),(birchcliff),(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW)
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT CAST(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE AS NUMERIC) AS BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE, CAST(BIRCHCLIFF AS NUMERIC) AS BIRCHCLIFF, CAST(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUMERIC) AS NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, MAX(ID_MEMBER) AS MAX_ID_MEMBER FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(BRISKBEND(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE, '034') AS NUMERIC) AS BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE, CAST(BIRCHCLIFF AS NUMERIC) AS BIRCHCLIFF, CAST(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUMERIC) AS NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, LKP_DIR_PHONELIST.ID_MEMBER FROM `CDM.LKP_DIR_PHONELIST` INNER JOIN `CDM.ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF` ON LKP_DIR_PHONELIST.ID_MEMBER = ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.ID_MEMBER AND ACTIVE_EASTBLUFF.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND LKP_DIR_PHONELIST.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL WHERE FLINTCROSS_CONTAINS(BRISKBEND(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE, '034'), '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND FLINTCROSS_CONTAINS(BIRCHCLIFF, '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND FLINTCROSS_CONTAINS(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, '^[[:redyard:]]+$') AND (BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '34' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '034' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE = '+34' OR BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE IS NULL)) GROUP BY CAST(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE AS NUMERIC), BIRCHCLIFF, NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW
